# TeamWheels

> TeamWheels turns Microsoft Teams into a corporate carpooling platform: no extra app to install, a conversational matching bot, an admin dashboard for HR, Facilities and Sustainability teams, and Scope 3 / Forfait Mobilité Durable reporting out of the box.

TeamWheels is bilingual (English and French) and serves organisations in the USA, UK, Canada and France. Microsoft Partner certified, Azure AD / Entra ID SSO, GDPR compliant, deployed in 5 minutes from Microsoft AppSource.

This file follows the [llms.txt convention](https://llmstxt.org/). Agents that ingest this index should follow the language-specific full-corpus dumps below for complete content.

## Full corpus

- [English full corpus](https://www.teamwheelsapp.com/en/llms-full.txt): Every primary page and blog post in English, concatenated as Markdown for retrieval.
- [French full corpus](https://www.teamwheelsapp.com/fr/llms-full.txt): Every primary page and blog post in French, concatenated as Markdown for retrieval.

## Primary pages — English

- [Home (EN)](https://www.teamwheelsapp.com/en/): Employee carpooling built into Microsoft Teams — overview, key figures, features.
- [How it works](https://www.teamwheelsapp.com/en/how-it-works/): Five-minute deployment, conversational bot, admin dashboard, Scope 3 reporting.
- [Benefits](https://www.teamwheelsapp.com/en/benefits/): HR, Sustainability and Facilities benefits — retention, parking demand, ESG, commuter benefits.
- [Pricing](https://www.teamwheelsapp.com/en/pricing/): Flat €5 / seat / month, free 30-day trial up to 50 employees, FAQ.
- [Contact](https://www.teamwheelsapp.com/en/contact/): Demo request form, sales contact, deployment support.
- [Savings calculator](https://www.teamwheelsapp.com/en/tools/savings-calculator/): Calculate annual CO₂ avoided, parking saved and commuter savings for your organisation.

## Cornerstone guides — English

- [Corporate Carpooling Guide 2026](https://www.teamwheelsapp.com/en/blog/corporate-carpooling-guide-2026/): Definitive guide for HR and Sustainability leaders — IRS commuter benefits, Clean Air Zones, Scope 3, vendor comparison.
- [How to Launch a Corporate Carpooling Program in 30 Days](https://www.teamwheelsapp.com/en/blog/how-to-launch-corporate-carpooling-program/): Four-week procedure (HowTo schema) for planning, piloting and rolling out an employee carpooling programme.
- [UK Employee Carpooling: Complete Guide](https://www.teamwheelsapp.com/en/blog/uk-employee-carpooling-complete-guide/): UK-specific tax, Clean Air Zone and HMRC compliance for corporate carpooling.
- [Scope 3 Employee Commuting — USA Compliance Guide](https://www.teamwheelsapp.com/en/blog/scope-3-employee-commuting-corporate-carpooling-usa-compliance-guide/): How corporate carpooling reduces Scope 3 Category 7 emissions for SEC and CSRD reporting.
- [Carpooling Savings Calculator: Corporate CO₂ & ROI 2026](https://www.teamwheelsapp.com/en/blog/carpooling-savings-calculator-corporate-co2-roi-2026/): ROI methodology and benchmarks behind the on-site calculator.
- [Carpooling Lanes Worldwide: Australia, UK, USA Guide](https://www.teamwheelsapp.com/en/blog/carpooling-lanes-worldwide-australia-uk-usa-guide/): HOV / T2 / T3 lane regulations and incentives across the US, UK and Australia.

## Cornerstone guides — French

- [Covoiturage entreprise : guide 2026](https://www.teamwheelsapp.com/fr/blog/covoiturage-entreprise-guide-2026/): Guide complet covoiturage en entreprise — fiscalité, FMD, RSE, comparatif fournisseurs.
- [Covoiturage entreprise : 5 étapes pour démarrer](https://www.teamwheelsapp.com/fr/blog/covoiturage-entreprise-5-etapes-demarrer/): Procédure en 4 semaines (schéma HowTo) pour lancer un programme de covoiturage domicile-travail.
- [Forfait Mobilité Durable : guide complet 2025](https://www.teamwheelsapp.com/fr/blog/forfait-mobilite-durable-guide-complet-2025/): Cadre légal, montants (jusqu'à 800 €/an), exonérations sociales et fiscales, mise en place.
- [Voies de covoiturage en France : avantages et guide](https://www.teamwheelsapp.com/fr/blog/voies-covoiturage-france-avantages-guide-collegues/): Voies réservées covoiturage et utilisation pour les trajets domicile-travail.
- [Voies de covoiturage Paris (Périphérique) — guide 2026](https://www.teamwheelsapp.com/fr/blog/voies-covoiturage-paris-peripherique-guide-2026/): Voie réservée du Périphérique parisien : règles, contrôle, sanctions.
